# METAUTO.ai
> Personal research homepage of Mingchen Zhuge, focused on AI agents, coding agents, multi-agent systems, recursive self-improvement, and neural computers.

- Home: https://metauto.ai/
- Blog: https://metauto.ai/blog/

- This file: https://metauto.ai/llms.txt

## Person
- Name: Mingchen Zhuge
- Role: Founding Member at Recursive; recent PhD graduate
- Affiliation: Recursive; KAUST alumnus
- PhD Advisor: Prof. Jürgen Schmidhuber
- Topics: AI agents, coding agents, multi-agent systems, agentic societies and economies, recursive self-improvement, open-ended evaluation, multimodal reasoning, world models, neural computers
- Research Profile: 20+ top-tier publications and 8,000+ citations
